mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.parent_id, r.child_id, r.merchant_category_id AS category_id, c.name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON r.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{permissionId}

SELECT r.id, r.parent_id, r.child_id, r.merchant_category_id AS category_id, c.name, r.reason, r.status, r.created_at FROM T_TDP_REQ_L r JOIN T_MCC_CTGR_C c ON r.merchant_category_id = c.id WHERE r.child_id = #{childId} AND DATE(r.created_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) FROM T_TDP_REQ_L WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TDP_REQ_L (parent_id, child_id, merchant_category_id, reason, status, expired_at, created_at) VALUES ( #{parentId}, #{childId}, #{categoryId}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), NOW() )
